# Klavierstück XI traversal constraint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:fixtureKlavierstuckConstraint`](gmeow-fixtureKlavierstuckConstraint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/fixtureKlavierstuckConstraint>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

The mobile-form constraint for the Klavierstück XI fixture: choose any fragment that has not been played too often, respecting the [`mayFollow`](../properties/gmeow-mayFollow.md) graph, and stop when a fragment has been reached three times.
